Credited 600 dpi print-ready fan rendition of [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138]], from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. It is a qualified later full-face comparison, not the original documentary image.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BAkIUDq7-mvahBFfIYiIZxVjlGlMyG_w/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,300 bytes, SHA-256 <code>6461374201743ef640c252bdce9f5e9f22ee1919db5144f0b9a8a9bfe28db91d</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited gold-E full-face fan rendition is a qualified comparison, not a high-resolution scan of the actual 1998 documentary entry at [[Bespin Motors Void Spider THX 1138 (Errata)]]. The fan prints a star; the published document prints literal W. Original TIFF/master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
